name: clono-vivliostyle-capabilities-research
description: Reproducible samples for researching Vivliostyle and VFM capabilities for clono

scripts.build:baseline: npm run build:baseline:html && npm run build:baseline:pdf
scripts.build:baseline:html: mkdir -p output/baseline && vfm cases/baseline/manuscript.md --title Baseline --language ja --style ../../styles/base.css > output/baseline/baseline.html
scripts.build:footnotes:minimal: npm run build:footnotes:minimal:html && npm run build:footnotes:minimal:pdf
scripts.build:footnotes:minimal:html: mkdir -p output/footnotes/minimal && vfm cases/footnotes/minimal/manuscript.md --title 'Minimal Footnote' --language ja --style ../../../cases/footnotes/minimal/footnotes.css > output/footnotes/minimal/default.html && vfm cases/footnotes/minimal/manuscript.md --title 'Minimal Footnote' --language ja --style ../../../cases/footnotes/minimal/footnotes.css --footnote pandoc > output/footnotes/minimal/pandoc.html && vfm cases/footnotes/minimal/manuscript.md --title 'Minimal Footnote' --language ja --style ../../../cases/footnotes/minimal/footnotes.css --footnote dpub > output/footnotes/minimal/dpub.html && vfm cases/footnotes/minimal/manuscript.md --title 'Minimal Footnote' --language ja --style ../../../cases/footnotes/minimal/footnotes.css --footnote gcpm > output/footnotes/minimal/gcpm.html
